components.title: PlannerFacade + stable boundary
components.rationale: src/index.ts declares PlannerFacade as the sole public entry point; PlannerFacade validates canonical inputs and delegates into planner-owned services.

components.title: Executable subgraph derivation
components.rationale: Derives the selected executable closure from workspace authoring truth and execution-selection intent.

components.title: Input normalization and graph-source mapping
components.rationale: Maps validated contract envelopes and manifest-derived graph sources into the planner domain input.

components.title: Deterministic planning pipeline
components.rationale: Planner is the domain service orchestrating validation, graph construction, policies, selection, topology, step construction and immutable plan assembly.

components.title: Graph construction and topology
components.rationale: Owns graph building, topological ordering and depth calculation used by deterministic planning and executable-closure derivation.

components.title: Node selection
components.rationale: Resolves the nodes participating in execution from the normalized graph and planner selection.

components.title: Immutable plan assembly
components.rationale: Builds the canonical plan material, hashes deterministic inputs and projects execution decisions into the final plan.

components.title: Execution-step factory
components.rationale: Maps graph nodes and resolved policies into deterministic execution steps.

components.title: Planner-owned behavior contracts
components.rationale: Planner-owned extension and validation boundaries kept behind explicit contracts.

components.title: Runtime clock boundary
components.rationale: Small runtime timing boundary used for planner timeout and metrics measurement without changing deterministic plan material.

components.title: Artifact compatibility bridge
components.rationale: Explicit transitional bridge: ICompiledCodeStorage has moved to @dvt/artifacts and this planner path is marked for removal.
